title: Lamentations Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Lamentations 5: a prayer over lost houses, famine, the fallen crown and the desolate mountain of Zion.

questions.text: What does the speaker ask Yahweh to do in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:1 asks Yahweh to remember what has come on them and to look and see their reproach.

answers.text: Destroy the nations that are around them for ever
Remember what has come on them and see their reproach
Send them another prophet to speak his words
Rebuild the temple and the walls of the city

questions.text: According to verse 2, to whom has their inheritance been turned over?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:2 says their inheritance has been turned over to strangers and their houses to aliens.

answers.text: To strangers, and their houses to aliens
To the Egyptians, and their fields to Assyria
To the priests of Zion, and their land to the elders
To the kings of the earth, and their vineyards to Edom

questions.text: To whom have they given their hands in order to be satisfied with bread?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:6 says they have given their hands to the Egyptians and to the Assyrians to be satisfied with bread.

answers.text: To the Babylonians and the Chaldeans
To the Edomites and the Moabites
To the kings of Judah
To the Egyptians and the Assyrians

questions.text: Who rule over them, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:8 says servants rule over them and there is no one to deliver them out of their hand.

answers.text: Princes
Elders
Servants
Young men

questions.text: Why is their skin black like an oven?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:10 says their skin is black like an oven because of the burning heat of famine.

answers.text: Because of the burning heat of famine
Because of the smoke of the fires
Because of the sun of the wilderness
Because of the ashes of mourning

questions.text: What happened to the princes, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:12 says princes were hanged up by their hands and the faces of elders were not honored.

answers.text: They were carried away in chains
They were made to carry millstones
They were seated at the gate
They were hanged up by their hands

questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:13 says the young men carry millstones and the children stumbled under loads of wood.

answers.text: The elders
The young men
The women of Zion
The princes

questions.text: What has fallen from their head?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:16 says the crown has fallen from their head, and cries woe to them because they have sinned.

answers.text: The turban
A garland of flowers
The crown
The covering of mourning

questions.text: What walks on the mountain of Zion, which is desolate?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:18 says that the mountain of Zion is desolate and the foxes walk on it.

answers.text: The jackals
The eagles
The ostriches
The foxes

questions.text: What does the speaker ask of Yahweh in verse 21?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:21 asks Yahweh to turn them to himself, so that they will be turned, and to renew their days as of old.

answers.text: To send fire on their enemies
To remember the righteousness of their fathers
To turn them to himself and renew their days as of old
To repay the nations for what they have done
